prompts.window_ornament: Production runtime asset for Undertow, matching the locally shown approved port-city/04-hillside-houses.png and 10-isometric-city-block.png. Dense hand-painted Art Nouveau port-city craft, carved pale cool limestone, worn black/verdigris iron, restrained brushwork and damp blue-hour patina. Uniform soft neutral diffuse light, UNLIT base art. No gold/amber/yellow/orange glow, lamps reflected in surfaces, magic, rings, people, text, signs, labels, borders, backdrop, checkerboard or ground shadow. Genuine transparent RGBA background; transparent holes must have zero alpha. Center a single complete object with clear empty margins. One flat FRONT ELEVATION window ornament, not isometric and not perspective. Tall narrow rectangular window opening below a small triangular Art Nouveau transom/pediment. Overall sculpted stone and iron frame approximately 1:2 in width:height. Main rectangular glass opening occupies 77% of frame width centered, from 27% to 91% of frame height down from the top; triangular transom opening centered above it, its triangle base at 23% height and apex at 8% height. Both openings must be genuinely transparent empty cutouts, NOT black or opaque glass. Paint only the pale carved stone surround, a few slender sinuous dark iron mullions across the openings, sill, organic lily motif in triangular pediment corners, and fine age streaks. Outer silhouette transparent, window cutouts transparent. NO glowing or colored glass, curtains, interior, wall panel or baked lighting. Build coherent ornament that remains readable mapped to a narrow 38x66 pixel game facade.
